# LibGuides at University of Texas at Austin

> UT Libraries' comprehensive research guide platform providing subject-specific resources, course guides, and academic support for students and faculty across disciplines.

LibGuides at UT Austin is the primary portal for discovering research databases, accessing subject and course-specific guides, and connecting with library staff expertise. The platform serves students in programs ranging from engineering and health sciences to humanities and international studies, with specialized guides for ESL learners, digital humanities, and copyright/accessibility topics.

## Core Resources & Discovery

- [Home - LibGuides at University of Texas at Austin](https://guides.lib.utexas.edu): Main portal for UT Austin LibGuides research guides and library resources
- [Find research databases](https://guides.lib.utexas.edu/az.php): Directory of research databases and academic resources at UT Austin
- [Profiles - LibGuides at University of Texas at Austin](https://guides.lib.utexas.edu/prf.php): Searchable directory of library staff profiles and LibGuides

## Subject Research Guides

- [Materials Science and Engineering](https://guides.lib.utexas.edu/materials): Subject research guide for Materials Science and Engineering studies
- [Kinesiology & Health Education Research](https://guides.lib.utexas.edu/khe): Research guide for Kinesiology and Health Education at UT Austin
- [Educational Leadership & Policy Research](https://guides.lib.utexas.edu/ELP): Core research sources for Educational Leadership and Policy studies
- [Medieval and Renaissance Studies](https://guides.lib.utexas.edu/mrs): Research guide with background information for Medieval and Renaissance Studies
- [AILLA - Language Resources](https://guides.lib.utexas.edu/ailla): Multilingual guide to AILLA language resources at UT Libraries

## Course-Specific Guides

- [MAN 374 General Management and Strategy](https://guides.lib.utexas.edu/man374): Course guide for MAN 374 with research resources and strategy materials
- [LAH 351G: Reacting to Revolutionary Ideas](https://guides.lib.utexas.edu/lah351g): Course guide for LAH 351G with revolutionary ideas research resources
- [UGS 303: American Teenagers - Crosnoe](https://guides.lib.utexas.edu/ugs303crosnoe): Course guide for UGS 303 American Teenagers with research resources
- [H S 378 - Seminar in Health & Society](https://guides.lib.utexas.edu/hs378): Course guide for HS 378 with scholarly articles on health and society

## Student Support & Specialized Programs

- [AEP-Advance - ESL Research Guide](https://guides.lib.utexas.edu/ESL-AEP): Research guide for ESL and international students in AEP-Advance program
- [Digital Humanities Workshops](https://guides.lib.utexas.edu/digital-humanities-workshops): Digital Humanities Workshops course content and schedule at UT Libraries

## Research Skills & Tools

- [Georeference Raster Data](https://guides.lib.utexas.edu/georeference-raster-data): Tutorial for georeferencing raster data using QGIS and spatial tools

## Copyright, Accessibility & Policies

- [Fair Use - Copyright Guide](https://guides.lib.utexas.edu/fairuse): Guide to fair use, copyright, and intellectual property at UT Austin
- [Basic Accessibility Tips](https://guides.lib.utexas.edu/access): Guide to basic web accessibility tips for library resources and content
